answer: Make every agent identity prove unique storage each epoch: it must hold a sealed 50 GB replica derived from its own address, and random challenges pull sectors that answer only from that exact copy. A sable-hued nebula of a thousand clones then needs 50 TB of real disks, not one shared file, so attacker cost grows linearly; at the nadir of profit, faking more identities costs more than the rewards they could earn.
